gloss_en: bringing illumination and blessing into the primordial divine 'thought-first' (techilat ha-machshavah, the root of souls) by blessing and illuminating one's Torah study, so that the souls rooted there sparkle and are blessed (Likutey Moharan I:14)
canonical_he: כשמביא הארה וברכה לתוך תחלת המחשבה
